name: atlas
title: The Atlas journey — launch, browse, filter, open a colour, read its provenance
why:
F-091 criterion 2. Everything this walks past is covered by a render test, and a
render test cannot tell reachable from rendered: react-test-renderer mounts a screen
without a navigator, so "the row is in the tree" and "a person can tap it" are the same
sentence there and different sentences on a phone.

STEP 3 WALKS THE TAB BAR, not a button on Home. It used to tap `home.openAtlas`, one of the ten buttons Home carried until F-146 rewrote it as an editorial surface; F-145 had already made the Atlas a TAB. The journey kept tapping a control that no longer existed, and the generator caught it — the key was not in the catalogue. That is the point of a journey being generated from keys rather than from strings: a removed control fails the build instead of failing on a device.
